subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Should the canonical Feishu bind fix reinterpret `feishu:<value>` as a group peer, or preserve the existing `feishu:<account>` account form and add a separate peer/conversation syntax or plugin-owned resolver?
rationale: The PR changes a documented CLI grammar that writes persisted route bindings, and several open candidate PRs use different compatibility shapes; automation cannot choose the permanent public contract safely.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add peer resolution
options.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` stable and add an explicit peer syntax or channel-owned Feishu conversation-id resolver so existing account binds keep working.

options.title: Accept Feishu reinterpretation
options.body: Allow `feishu:<value>` to mean group peer, but require maintainer-owned docs, migration guidance, and upgrade proof for existing account-bound users.

options.title: Pause this PR and pick another candidate
options.body: Use another open candidate for the canonical Feishu issue if its grammar and proof better preserve compatibility.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add peer resolution
recommendation.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` stable and add an explicit peer syntax or channel-owned Feishu conversation-id resolver so existing account binds keep working.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent route and agent CLI docs work makes this the best available routing candidate for the public grammar decision.
